events.description: At 7:40 p.m. a “meteor” turned, looped, and curved for 12 seconds over Paris, France. Its tail lasted 90 seconds.

Three persons aboard the “Fort Salisbury,” including Second Officer A. H. Raymer, saw a huge, dark object bearing lights in the sea ahead. It was observed sinking slowly. Estimated length: 200 m.
Type: ufo sighting
